title: Our exciting Fraud Detection project demo!

cues.en: In this program, I'm going to show you how to train a machine learning model to detect fraud on a credit card fraud dataset.
cues.zh: 在這套課程中，我會示範如何使用信用卡詐欺資料集，訓練機器學習模型來偵測詐欺。

cues.en: Ultimately, with the intention of building out a full scale dashboard for fraud detection, that will
cues.zh: 最終目標是建立一套完整的詐欺偵測儀表板，讓我們

cues.en: allow us to toggle a threshold so we can compare a baseline model to an improved machine learning model with an updated thresholds.
cues.zh: 能調整門檻，比較基準模型與調整門檻後的改良機器學習模型。

cues.en: It will allow us to apply a total cost of fraud formula to the dashboard so we can attach a cost to
cues.zh: 我們也能在儀表板套用詐欺總成本公式，為

cues.en: our different misclassifications and correct classifications.
cues.zh: 各種錯誤分類與正確分類指定成本。

cues.en: So, for example, the cost of correctly detecting fraud, we're able to add a particular cost to this dashboard.
cues.zh: 例如，對於正確偵測到詐欺的情況，可以在儀表板設定一個特定成本。

cues.en: The threshold itself, we're able to toggle and change and get an updated array of scores.
cues.zh: 我們可以切換與調整門檻，取得更新後的一組評分。

cues.en: Then after we've included these updated costs, the dashboard itself will calculate a total cost of fraud for our default model and then for an updated model.
cues.zh: 輸入這些更新後的成本後，儀表板就會計算預設模型與更新模型各自的詐欺總成本。

cues.en: And then we can make a trade off or a decision in terms of which we would like to proceed with.
cues.zh: 接著就能權衡利弊，決定要採用哪一個模型。

cues.en: Then finally, the Streamlit dashboard that we're going to program with the Python programming language
cues.zh: 最後，我們會用 Python 撰寫 Streamlit 儀表板，

cues.en: gives us an overall summary of the classification metrics for both the baseline model as well as for
the updated model with the updated classification where we'll look at the area under the curve.
cues.zh: 使用新分類門檻的更新模型之分類指標，並檢視曲線下面積。

cues.en: The area under the precision Recall curve will make note of what the classification threshold is for the default model as well as for the updated model.
cues.zh: 我們會查看精確率－召回率曲線下面積，並記錄預設模型與更新模型的分類門檻。

cues.en: And then we will look at each of the elements within the confusion matrix so the number of correctly identified fraudulent and non fraudulent transactions and so on.
cues.zh: 接著檢視混淆矩陣的各個項目，例如正確辨識出的詐欺交易與非詐欺交易數量。
